description: Turning the flag off returns every delegation to read/notify, releases leases without consuming attempts, refuses native routes with 404, and leaves Stage 1 and canonical work intact.

steps.does: native sessions behave as read/notify; leases held by the gateway are released as held/queued with no attempt consumed; sent replies stay sent; pending owner requests stay visible
Stage 1 check and acknowledgement endpoints, the notification ledger and presence are unchanged
re-enabling requires current owner scope approval for each delegation: native_work is never resurrected from the stored record
